title: Fast company
description: A compact typographic strip leans with scrolling speed and relaxes when movement stops.
useCase: Make a bounded editorial scroll treatment respond to the reader rather than an autoplay loop.
reducedMotion: Reduced motion keeps the lettering static while its scroll surface remains available. Changing the preference live immediately removes translation and skew.
limitations: Original demonstration content; adapt labels and state to the host product.
look: Saturated orange field with stacked oversized type alternating heavy rust sans-serif and dark brown italic serif lines, plus a small circled arrow bottom right.
motion: Scrolling slides the type left at 0.32× scroll distance and skews it up to 15° by scroll speed; skew eases back to zero 100 ms after scrolling stops.
adapt: The `onScroll` handler sets `skew` from `velocity * 6` (clamped to ±15°) and a `translateX` of 0.32× `offset`; `timer` zeroes the skew after 100 ms and `.type` eases transforms over 0.16 s. Replace the lettering and palette in `.sf-velocity-type`.
